construction_notes: SOURCE OF TRUTH: WG105 Kiko puppet VERSION 004 (v3 outline cuts + v4 floater cleanup + right-shoe restoration), built 2026-11-07. Source art: owner-accepted generative completion WG_KIKO_REFERENCE_COMPLETED_GEN_20261107.png. Cut by cut_kiko_v3.py (OFFICIAL-FLA-QUALITY cuts: every part boundary follows a line drawn in the artwork itself). v4 changed NOTHING else: no re-cutting; outline boundaries, pivots, poses, stacking and timing are byte-for-byte the v2/v3 specs (POSES identical, PIV identical, STACK identical, every part matrix identical for all 8 poses).

This BlairWitch package is VERSION 005: same 16 parts, same pivots, same stack, same 8-pose choreography as v4 — re-expressed through the BlairWitch rig/sheet/puppet system (Harmony construction, standard tier). It does NOT overwrite v4.

PARTS (16, full-canvas 1184x2096 PNGs, stack bottom-to-top): thigh_L, thigh_R, shin_L, shin_R, shoe_L, shoe_R, torso, coat_L, coat_R, upper_arm_L, upper_arm_R, forearm_L, forearm_R, hand_L, hand_R, head. Pivots per part in kiko-v4 parts.json (v4 source). Joint overlaps are the neighbouring part's own source pixels tucked underneath (hip 50px, knee 50px/45px, ankle 45px, elbow 45px, wrist 55px).

POSES (8, per-part rot/dx/dy specs + hierarchical composition: forearm/hand under upper_arm, shin/shoe under thigh — same method as build_ashes.py): NEUTRAL, ARMS_RAISED, POINT_R, STEP_FORWARD, HOOD_TILT_BOW, WAVE_L, GUARD, REST_LEAN. Pose specs live in this package under poses/ as JSON.

MOUTH DISCIPLINE NOTE: the four Rule-17 declarations are the mouth-symbol system's rules. v4 art carries no separate mouth drawings (void face), so the discipline binds mouth drawings when authored for the Blair 10 + expression frames 11+, not existing art.

EYES NOTE: standard BlairWitch eye system is the rig scaffold (four-piece masked eye, pupil/lid/brow frames). v4 art has no separate eye layers — the void face's starry glints are baked into the head part.

PALETTE: sampled from the assembled v4 neutral figure's opaque pixels (dominant colours), recorded as the §2 four-slot sheet (Dominant / Support / Accent / Ink) with CMYK + sanctioned tints. No invented colours.

GAPS LOGGED, NEVER INVENTED: no three-quarter / side / back views exist in v4 art (front view only); no separate eye/mouth/hand-variant drawings; no walk-cycle art beyond the 8 poses. The sheet shows the front turnaround honestly and lists the missing views as gaps.

V4 floater audit: 13,854 floater px + 18,055 pool px + 8,381 pass-2 px + 1,693 pass-3 px removed; 6,013 px reassigned torso-to-thighs; 11,857 px restored to shoe_R (whole toe + lace loops). Full per-component log in the v4 work folder (work/floater_audit.json).
line_weight: as-drawn in WG_KIKO_REFERENCE_COMPLETED_GEN_20261107.png (owner-accepted generative completion); numeric stroke width unmeasured — to be measured at sheet review
name: Kiko
special_features: KIKO pendant + neck chains (drawn; chains are many separate link components in the torso art)
Fur-trimmed hooded coat / mantle (coat_L + coat_R are one connected fur mass behind the hood)
Starry void face — star glints baked into the head part; hood + void face are ONE piece, no separate eye layers
Kneepad on shin_R (its own drawn outline)
Fur wrist cuffs on forearm_L / forearm_R; fur elbow bands on upper_arm_L / upper_arm_R
watch_fors: HEAD IS HOOD + VOID FACE AS ONE PIECE — Kiko has no separate eye layers in any v4 source; the starry eye glints are baked into the void face. No blink/eye-swap art exists. The BlairWitch eye system (four-piece masked eye) and Blair 10 viseme mouth frames are the rig's symbol slots; they bind mouth/eye drawings WHEN authored, not existing art. Do not claim v4 ships them.
HANDS ARE OPEN, FINGERS DOWN ONLY — no alternate hand poses exist in this art. SHARED/hands links the generic hand library; Kiko's drawn hands are the v4 hand_L / hand_R parts.

SHOULDER NOTCH — the source is flat, so a full overhead raise can open a notch at the shoulder where no art exists behind the arm (same physical limit as the Ashes set). ARMS_RAISED / WAVE_L are the affected poses.
HANDS CLIP THE FRAME EDGES in ARMS_RAISED / WAVE_L / POINT_R (owner-approved choreography, carried over from v3).
DARK WEDGE BETWEEN THE THIGHS on wide leg poses (carried over from v3).

FUSED SPLASH REMAINDERS (painted onto the character in the source art itself, not removable without re-cutting inside v3-approved boundaries): orange flame burst fused along shin_R outer edge; blue/purple splash fused under coat_L outer tail tip and across the coat tails' lower ends; one coat tail-tip strand showing as a small droplet between the thighs in STEP_FORWARD (attached garment); thin paint skin under the shoe soles at the ground-contact line; ~10 px orange edge fleck at coat_L inner edge in ARMS_RAISED / WAVE_L.
LEFT KNEE has no garment edge in the art; the seam follows the leg's drawn contour pinch and the flame-pattern line at the knee, thigh tucked 50px under the shin.
coat_L / coat_R overlap each other 80px under the hood (hidden by the head part in every pose) instead of a visible split line.
